jobs.title: Working Student - LLM Quantization & Inference Performance
jobs.description: About Tensordyne (formerly Recogni) AI is transforming our world. It can perform cognitive functions that previously only humans could do, such as perceiving interactions across different modalities and environments - with the ability to quickly learn and then solve complex problems. Tensordyne is an AI system solution company that builds very high-performance, low-power generative AI inference systems. Our mission, through the creation of custom silicon, hardware and software, is to enable multimodal Generative AI inference acceleration at scale, with safe, sustainable, high-performance systems for our hyperscaler and neocloud data center customers. We are at the leading edge of advancing the latest research and product improvements for generative Al inference solutions that will make Al even more advantageous for compelling new generative AI applications.Tensordyne is a well funded, fast-paced startup company with headquarters in both Sunnyvale, CA, and Munich, Germany. We also have many talented team members working remotely across North America and Europe. We take care of our people and their families with comprehensive benefits, competitive compensation, flexible spending options, and recognition programs, because building category-defining technology starts with a healthy, supported team. Come join us as we shape the future of multimodal generative artificial intelligence! Role summary How much numerical precision does an LLM need, and where in the model architecture does it matter most? When does quantization improve runtime, and what does it cost in model quality? We're looking for a motivated working student to help turn these questions into experiments and experiments into maintainable code. You'll explore optimization methods and build reusable evaluation tooling. You'll work closely with our quantization, compiler, and runtime engineers, and your findings will directly influence how we optimize models for Tensordyne hardware. What you will do Model quality evaluation: Measure how low-precision computation affects performance on coding and reasoning benchmarks. Diagnose where quantization has the greatest impact. Quantization research: Implement and compare post-training quantization methods to improve inference efficiency while preserving task accuracy. Build reproducible tooling: Automate evaluations, track configurations and results, and make experiments accessible to engineers and AI agents. Measure runtime performance: Characterize latency, throughput, and memory usage to understand bottlenecks under different deployment scenarios. A first project could involve exploring the quality–performance Pareto frontier of a Qwen or LlaMa model. You'll experiment with 16-bit, 8-bit, and 4-bit quantization configurations to find the best runtime-quality tradeoff. Core qualifications Current enrollment in Computer Science, Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, Machine Learning, or a related master's degree program. Strong Python and PyTorch skills, including the ability to understand and modify model implementations. Effective use of AI coding tools and critical review of their output. An experimental mindset: you can formulate hypotheses, design comparisons, and draw careful conclusions from noisy results. Clear communication and the ability to present experimental findings and technical tradeoffs to the team. Strong pluses: experience with quantization, LLM evaluation, performance profiling, or inference optimization. This role is for you if you thrive on responsibility, learn quickly, and are naturally proactive . What we offer Join a deep-tech team building the next generation of AI inference systems. Put your university knowledge into practice with leading open-source LLMs, deepen your understanding of quantization and inference optimization, and build skills in experimental design, software engineering, and AI coding tools. jobs.title: Digital Director
jobs.description: GumGum is The Mindset Company™ transforming advertising. We're an advertising technology company delivering results by matching brands with people in the right mindset in the moments that matter. Our platform is powered by the Mindset Graph™, our AI-driven data engine that processes billions of real-time contextual, creative, environmental, and historical signals to match every ad with the most receptive audience. The result is advertising that drives meaningful outcomes for advertisers and publishers, and is more relevant for consumers. We were founded in 2008 and are headquartered in Santa Monica, California, operating in over 19 markets across North America, Europe, Japan, and Australia. Our principles guide our work every day and are as follows: Customer-Obsessed: We're focused on advertising solutions that solve needs and drive success for clients and partners. Make it Happen: We have a bias for action and take ownership to deliver results. Always Innovate: We push boundaries with creativity and technology. Foster Belonging: We ensure colleagues feel included, supported, and empowered to thrive. To be a part of The Mindset Company™ transforming advertising, please visit www.gumgum.com/careers . Based in Manchester, the Digital Director, Regional UK is an autonomous individual contributor responsible for prospecting, negotiating, and closing advertising sales across the North of England. Reporting to the Regional Sales Lead and supported by a cross-functional pre-sales team, the role focuses on managing a large book of business, developing strategic relationships within large and mid-sized agencies, and upselling GumGum's product portfolio. The Director leverages deep digital media expertise to independently solve complex client challenges, translate client feedback into internal product insights, and drive consistent regional revenue growth. What You'll Achieve Drive regional UK revenue by managing a book of business and closing new business across large and mid-sized agencies in the North of England. Generate a high volume of prospecting activity, including cold outreach, pitch presentations, RFPs, and tailored sales solutions. Upsell existing brand and agency clients on both established and new GumGum advertising products. Cultivate and expand strategic relationships across client-direct brands, media agency contacts, and holding company teams. Collaborate cross-functionally with Account Managers, Client Strategists, and pre-sales teams to ensure sold proposals are executed accurately. Translate market and client insights back to internal product teams to help refine and adapt platform offerings. Exercise independent judgment and discretion to solve client challenges and select optimal ad solutions with minimal managerial oversight. Skills You'll Bring 5+ years of digital advertising sales experience with a proven track record of meeting or exceeding targets. Demonstrated experience managing a large book of business, backed by an established network of regional brand and agency contacts. Solid understanding of the digital media and advertising landscape; programmatic background preferred. Proficiency with Salesforce for activity tracking, client logging, and pipeline reporting. Working proficiency in Google Suite, Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, and Word. Strong presentation, relationship-building, and interpersonal communication skills across all client hierarchy levels. Self-motivated, highly proactive, and extraverted approach with an eagerness to entertain clients and adapt to evolving strategies. What We Offer Learn about our benefits & perks package at gumgum.com/benefits . If you'd like additional information, your recruiter can share more specifics during the hiring process! Note: This position offers the opportunity for remote work or 'work from home' as there isn't a nearby office. jobs.description: About Wolt At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe. Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. About the Team Our Infrastructure teams build the foundation that engineers at Wolt, Deliveroo, and DoorDash build on: the compute, cloud, and networking capabilities that enable Engineering teams to develop, deploy, and run services at global scale. The EU Compute team has a specific focus on provisioning, scaling, and the efficient operation of GPU infrastructure for AI and ML workloads. This is an emerging space with plenty of greenfield opportunities. We're looking for a Staff Engineer to be a hands-on technical leader for this infrastructure work that crosses team and brand boundaries. You'll set direction for the platform, turn complex problems into deliverable plans, write and review production code, and help other engineers make sound decisions. It's an exciting time to join: we're building a global platform and the choices made now will shape how engineers across the company ship for years. What you'll be doing You'll own some of the hardest infrastructure problems in the company and make the platform easier to operate and safer to build on. We're determined to build great platform products and user experiences, and you'll be pivotal in making this reality. Day-to-day in this role you'll: Set technical direction for shared AWS and Kubernetes infrastructure, balancing reliability, security, developer experience, and cost. Lead substantial initiatives from design through rollout and operation, coordinating dependencies and decisions across Wolt, Deliveroo and DoorDash, focusing on workloads targeting GPUs. Evolve Kubernetes clusters, cloud networking, identity, and infrastructure provisioning to support growing and varied workloads. Build reusable Terraform patterns and self-service tooling that help teams provision infrastructure safely and consistently. Improve deployment and operational practices, including GitOps, observability, capacity planning, incident response and recovery. Use production signals and developer feedback to find platform friction, choose where to invest and measure whether changes actually help. Assist with supporting the platform, with deep focus on GPU infrastructure, as well as broad focus on compute in general. Gracefully sunset legacy infrastructure and tooling, and create strategies to reduce toil. Mentor engineers through design reviews, implementation and incidents, raising the quality of infrastructure work across teams. Our humble expectations Deep experience building and operating Kubernetes and AWS infrastructure in production. Familiarity with GPU workloads and orchestration is a plus. Strong software engineering skills: you use Go, Python or a similar language to build maintainable tools and automation. Experience with infrastructure as code (we use Terraform) and with designing systems that other engineering teams depend on. A track record of leading complex technical work across teams, including architectural decisions, delivery, and operational follow-through. You have the breadth to collaborate and design across team and domain boundaries, and the depth to have hands-on impact. Strong judgment on trade-offs in distributed systems, networking, security, reliability, and cloud cost. Clear communication, and the ability to bring people together around a practical technical

jobs.title: Golang Backend Engineer, Financial Product Fraud
jobs.description: Our Global Structure Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team. Your job is to make sure every payout and transaction lands with the right person. We have spent years getting very good at protecting the things a marketplace has always had to protect: checkout fraud, account takeover, courier abuse. But we are no longer only a marketplace. We now issue banking products, lend to merchants, move instant payouts to couriers, and collect cash on the doorstep. Every one of those is a new way for money to leave the platform. This is a new team, and it owns that surface: fraud wherever money moves through the platform. Who receives it, who lends it, who collects it, and who holds it in a financial account. Think instant payout rails, merchant cash advances, and platform-issued banking and earned-wage products serving millions of couriers and merchants. These are live loss surfaces, and the volume grows with every financial product we launch. We are now looking for a Backend Engineer (Golang) to build that protection. You will design and ship real-time detection and automated enforcement for our financial products across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo. The work is high-throughput, low-latency, and unusually consequential: a rule you ship on Monday can stop a serious loss by Friday. It is also close to greenfield, so you will be setting the patterns every future financial product inherits on day one. This role will be based in London , UK as one of the founding engineering roles in our London hub, working closely with our teams in Helsinki and Berlin. What you'll do: Build and maintain high-throughput, low-latency backend services in Go that score financial events in real time, including payout enrollments, bank account links, credit applications, and account-to-account transfers. Design fraud detection and automated enforcement for our financial products end to end: from signal collection through to the decision that blocks a fraudulent payout. Build on and extend our shared fraud decisioning platform, so signals, rules, and models work across all three of our brands instead of being rebuilt three times. Partner closely with risk analysts, data scientists, and product managers to turn observed fraud patterns into shipped detection, and to know when a rule, a model, or a product change is the right answer. Work across team boundaries with our account security, payments fraud, and financial product teams. We build on their signals rather than rebuild them, so clean interfaces matter. Contribute to architectural discussions and technical decisions as we establish the fraud infrastructure baseline for financial products, with support from senior engineers on the team. Write well-tested, observable code and help the team hold a high quality bar. In fraud, a silent failure is a loss event. Our expectations: 3 to 6 years of professional software engineering experience, including backend services you have shipped and owned in production. 1+ years of production experience in Golang, or strong experience in another backend language and real enthusiasm for picking Go up quickly. A working understanding of low-latency, high-throughput distributed systems. Real-time decisioning comes with a latency budget, and you are keen to learn to build inside one. Hands-on experience with SQL and/or NoSQL databases, and some exposure to event-driven architectures (Kafka or similar). Willingness to operate what you build, including a share of on-call, with a pragmatic approach to reliability. Uses AI tooling in day-to-day development and can critically evaluate its output for correctness and quality. Nice to have Experience in fraud, risk, payments, lending, or financial crime, especially money movement fraud, bank account linking fr

We make sure iwoca meets its regulatory obligations, particularly the financial crime, sanctions and data protection requirements that apply across our suite of products and services. We are the second line of defence for the UK business. We advise the people building and running the business on what the rules require, set the policies and standards they work to, and test whether what happens in practice matches them. We work alongside the product teams so that each product meets its obligations and can grow. Data protection is central to what we do. We hold the data privacy function for the UK business and own how iwoca handles personal data end to end: the lawful basis for how customer, applicant and third-party data is used; data subject access requests and other individual rights; personal data breaches; retention and deletion; records of processing; marketing and consent; the privacy review of new products and features; and the governance of automated decisioning and AI tooling. How we work: We enable rather than block. The answer is rarely just “no” — it’s what it would take to get to yes, and what the firm is accepting if it goes ahead anyway. We go to the source. Positions are grounded in the actual rule, regulation or guidance, and we can show where they come from. We’re proportionate. Controls match the risk in front of us. We don’t build process for its own sake. We’re close to the business. We work directly with Tech, Data, Credit, Operations and Legal, and we want to be in the room early rather than at the end. Your primary focus will be the statutory core: data subject access requests, data protection impact assessments, legitimate interests assessments, personal data breaches and records of processing. The role is not only to run that work but to improve it. A significant part of the job is identifying where our privacy operations could be automated, supported by AI or otherwise improved, assessing what each option would take and what it would mean for compliance, and specifying it well enough for our Tech and Data teams to deliver. jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer
jobs.description: About Payflows At Payflows, we build software that helps large companies manage and automate their payment workflows. It’s not the flashiest part of a business, but it’s one of the most critical: invoices, approvals, payments, and controls. When these things slow down, the whole company feels it. But our ambition goes further than just building a better workflow tool. We believe the future of finance operations is not faster clicking: it’s no clicking at all 🫳 🎤 Finance teams shouldn’t spend their days moving data from one screen to another. Software should do the operational work, and humans should focus on reviewing, approving, and making the decisions that matter. That’s the direction we’re building toward: an agent-driven finance platform , where intelligent agents handle the repetitive tasks, and users stay in control. We started in 2022 with a small team and a rough first version of the product. Three years later, we’re working with major companies across France, the UK, and the US while choosing to keep our team small and human-sized. jobs.title: Senior Applied Scientist - Behavior AI
jobs.description: <p>The Behavior AI team builds the AI-based anomaly detection behind Datadog's security products. Our models learn what normal looks like across the billions of logs, events, and telemetry records flowing through the platform every second, and they flag the behavior that does not fit, on every record, in real time, at a cost that makes sense at our scale. What we build does not ship to a single feature. The same models power detection across many of Datadog's security products at once, so the work has impact well beyond any one team. Large general-purpose models are too slow and too expensive to run in that path, so we take the opposite approach: small, custom models, designed for high-throughput stream processing and optimized to run cheaply on every record.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>We are hiring a Senior Applied Scientist to build these models from start to finish. You will contribute to designing the architecture, training at scale, and the optimization work that takes a model from training to running efficiently on production traffic. This optimization requires a deep understanding of the constraints imposed by both the software and the hardware, together with the applied mathematics to work within them: often it comes down to finding a mathematical reformulation that fits those constraints better, and that judgment can decide whether a model reaches production at all.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>The work involves a number of open questions. How do you obtain most of the quality of a large model from one that is far smaller and cheap enough to run on the full stream? Where is it worth trading exactness for speed, and how do you reason about the error you accept? How do you make a small model's outputs clear enough that the detection engineers and analysts who rely on it can trust what it reports? If these are the problems you want to work on, we would like to hear from you.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><em>At Datadog, we place value in our office culture: the relationships and collaboration it builds, and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.</em></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What You'll Do:</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Design and build custom mid-size models for high-throughput stream processing, and train them at scale.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Optimize these models from start to finish, working across both the mathematics and the systems, often by finding mathematical reformulations that fit the hardware and software constraints better.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Build the training data pipelines the work depends on when they do not already exist, from the raw stream to a training-ready dataset.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Work with engineering to integrate models into production, with a clear focus on GPU utilization, latency, and cost per record on live traffic.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Plan the roadmap of model and system improvements, based on a solid understanding of the product and of what matters most to users.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Build an agentic layer on top of the models to analyze, validate, and act on their outputs.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Build lightweight interpretability tools that make model behavior easier to explain to the people who rely on it.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Maintain and monitor the models, services, and infrastructure your team owns, and take part in your team's on

jobs.title: Senior Applied Scientist - AI Platform
jobs.description: <p>AI Platform builds the foundations of Datadog's AI efforts. The org is 70+ people organised in three pillars: training and serving (GPU clusters, distributed training, low-level infrastructure), agents (agent harnesses, memory systems, the internal AI gateway that routes every LLM request at Datadog), and evaluation and experimentation. This role sits in the evaluation and experimentation pillar, which owns Datadog's shared annotation and evaluation infrastructure — including the evaluation scenario store and the telemetry archival systems used across the Bits org. Together they let an agent travel back in time and query what Datadog looked like at the exact moment an incident happened, so scenarios can be replayed and agent performance tracked over time.</p> <p>Specifically, you'll be the first applied scientist on GenSim (Generative Simulations), the team that builds the environments Datadog's agents learn in. GenSim doesn't replay sampled telemetry — it stands up real, fully instrumented applications that talk to Datadog, drives them with representative traffic, injects controlled failures, and records what happens. Because GenSim injected the failure, it knows the ground truth. That corpus — hundreds of postmortem-derived scenarios and thousands of runnable applications — is today the primary source of post-training data for Datadog's own SRE model, and the substrate that Bits AI SRE and our other agents are trained and evaluated against.</p> <p>The team has no applied science support today and is learning post-training data methodology on the fly. That's the gap this role fills, and the open questions are the interesting part. How do you tell whether a generated environment is actually representative of the messy, incomplete telemetry real customers run — rather than a suspiciously clean one where every monitor exists and every service emits complete logs? How do you make injected problems genuinely hard, and how do you even measure difficulty? How do you define and control the quality of post-training data when correctness, representativeness and difficulty pull in different directions? How do you evaluate an agent end to end when the trajectory is non-deterministic? Creating simulated agent environments for monitoring and SRE work is not well solved in open source or in published research, and Datadog is the leading company in this field. If those are the problems you want to spend your time on, come build this with us.</p> <h2><strong>What You'll Do:</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Own the applied science direction for GenSim: set the methodology and the forward-looking technical calls on how simulated environments and post-training data should be built, on a team where that decision-making does not exist yet.</li> <li>Define, measure and raise the quality of post-training data — basic correctness, representativeness against the real distribution of customer systems and production telemetry, and difficulty — and make those measures something the team can act on release over release.</li> <li>Close the realism gap. Simulated environments today are too clean and the injected problems are not yet hard enough; you'll drive the research and the engineering that make them look like real, imperfect production systems.</li> <li>Build scalable, production-grade systems rather than research scripts. The output is not just a dataset — it is a system of synthetic environments that must be reliable and invokable inside a training loop.</li> <li>Determine how this data is best applied, in LLM post-training and in evaluation, and own the agent and LLM application evaluation approaches for these environments.</li> <li>Work cross-functionally with the engineers and applied scientists on adjacent teams — Bits AI SRE, the model training effort, and the wider evaluation and exper

jobs.description: Project Engineer Wil jij technische projecten van begin tot eind begeleiden? En wil je werken aan innovatieve oplossingen op het gebied van energieopslag en vermogenselektronica? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou! Wat ga je doen? Als Project Engineer begeleid je projecten binnen AEP Hybrid Power vanaf de technische overdracht na opdracht tot en met de oplevering. Jij bent de verbindende schakel tussen de klant, engineering, productiepartners, leveranciers en service. Je zorgt ervoor dat technische eisen, planning, budget, documentatie en testen goed op elkaar aansluiten. Je houdt overzicht, signaleert mogelijke problemen op tijd en zorgt ervoor dat acties en afspraken worden opgevolgd. jobs.title: Tender Manager
jobs.description: Do you want to take ownership of how tenders are won, rather than simply contributing to them? Valcon is looking for an experienced Bid Manager to take the lead across the entire bid and tender process. From identifying and qualifying opportunities to defining the strategy, coordinating decision-making, managing stakeholders, safeguarding quality and evaluating results. The primary focus will be on European public tenders. This is explicitly not a traditional bid writing role. Rather than spending your days writing proposals yourself, you ensure that the right people deliver the strongest possible content at the right time. You create structure, challenge subject-matter experts, safeguard the strategy and quality, and keep stakeholders aligned throughout the process. But in case of emergency it is important for you to also be able to write a tender yourself, which occasionally will happen. The principle is simple: don’t write it yourself – enable the team to write it better. What will you do? As Bid Manager, you will be responsible for the end-to-end management of bids and tenders. You will oversee the full tender pipeline and take the lead on complex bid processes involving multiple disciplines, seniority levels and stakeholder interests. Your responsibilities include: Centrally identifying, qualifying and prioritising relevant tenders and commercial opportunities; Organising and facilitating Go/No-Go decisions and according to the required approval process; Developing and safeguarding the bid strategy; Translating it into a clear plan and structured tender process; Independently leading multidisciplinary bid teams consisting of partners, managers, consultants, subject matter experts and in some cases external stakeholders; Managing timelines, progress, compliance and quality throughout the entire bid process; Organising reviews and critically assessing contributions before submission; Safeguarding legal and procedural requirements, particularly for European public tenders; Reporting on the tender pipeline, results and performance to the CRO; Evaluating completed bids and systematically translating lessons learned into improvements; Further developing governance, processes, tooling, knowledge management and reporting within the Tender Desk; Using data, technology and AI to make the bid process smarter, more efficient and more effective; Training and coaching colleagues who contribute to bids and helping to increase bid management maturity across the organisation; In case of emergency, it is important to also be able to write tenders yourself. As Bid Manager, you ensure that the overall process works: that the right people contribute, deadlines are met, decisions are made and strategy, quality and content come together. You are a Bid Manager, not a Bid Writer That distinction is important. At Valcon, consultants, partners and subject-matter experts provide the content and contribute to the actual writing of bids. Some colleagues will be specifically trained to participate regularly in tender processes, while others may have limited experience with public tenders. Your role is not to take over their writing. Instead, you ensure the team understands what is required, why it matters and when it needs to be delivered. You are therefore a project manager, strategist, quality gatekeeper and challenger at the same time. You are comfortable challenging an experienced consultant or partner when their contribution is not yet strong enough. You ask the right questions, keep the team focused on the agreed strategy and know how to create momentum without relying on formal authority. Strong stakeholder management is therefore essential. You need to be able to lead complex projects and influence senior stakeholders, partners and consultants across the organisation. Building the Tender Desk In addition to managing individual bids, you will have another important responsibility: further professionalising Tender Management within Valcon. A foun

jobs.title: Physician Assistant of Verpleegkundig Specialist
jobs.description: Wat ga je doen? Bij Cardiologie Centra Nederland, locatie Dokkum draai je zelfstandig spreekuur en ben je medisch inhoudelijk verantwoordelijk voor je eigen patiëntenpopulatie. Je stelt zelfstandig diagnose- en behandelplannen op, verricht risicostratificatie en begeleidt patiënten met uiteenlopende, complexe cardiologische beelden, zoals: Pijn op de borst (angina pectoris) en ischemische hartziekten; Hartritmestoornissen (o.a. atriumfibrilleren); Hartfalen, hypertensie en hypercholesterolemie; Hartkleplijden. Je combineert medisch-technische zorg met leefstijlgeneeskunde en langdurige opvolging. Waar nodig spar je op gelijkwaardige basis met de aanwezige cardiologen; de lijnen zijn bij ons kort en de sfeer is collegiaal. En omdat de inzet van een PA of VS bij onze locatie in Dokkum nieuw is, bieden we een kans: jij bouwt actief mee aan de vormgeving van deze rol en de polikliniek. Jouw visie, klinische blik en initiatief zijn hierin leidend. De locatie in Dokkum is gevestigd binnen het Sionsberg Netwerk Ziekenhuis. Je komt te werken in een toegankelijk en informeel team, waarin we echt voor elkaar klaarstaan. Bovendien biedt het werken in Dokkum rust en ruimte: gratis parkeren voor de deur, geen files en een prachtige omgeving. Bij CCN denken we mee over jouw ontwikkeling. Mocht jij jouw werk bijvoorbeeld op de cardiologie willen afwisselen met ervaring binnen bijvoorbeeld de traumatologie. Dan is dit zeker bespreekbaar na de opstart van deze nieuwe rol binnen onze poli cardiologie. Over ons: onze zorg klopt! We zijn een organisatie van zelfstandige behandelcentra voor hart- en vaatziekten die zich onderscheidt door poliklinische zorg perfect af te stemmen op de behoeften van de patiënt en de verwijzer. We geloven in de kracht van complete zorg onder één dak. Onze patiënten kunnen dicht bij huis terecht voor de meest hoogwaardige cardiologische zorg, en jij speelt daarin een belangrijke rol. We werken met geavanceerde hartritme-analyses (holtermonitoring), begeleiden patiënten op afstand via ons innovatieve e-health programma Hartwacht, en voeren poliklinisch elektrische cardioversies (ECV’s) uit. Met een eigen PM-technicus én een eigen spoedpolikliniek in huis is de dynamiek hoog. Daarnaast beschikken we binnenkort over onze eigen CT coronairen. Met deze modernste apparatuur brengen we lokaal, snel en non-invasief de kransslagaders in beeld, een fantastische kwaliteitsimpuls voor jouw diagnostische werk. Wie ben jij? Je hebt de Master Physician Assistant (MPA) óf Master Advanced Nursing Practice (MANP) afgerond en beschikt over een geldige BIG-registratie; Je hebt aantoonbare klinische ervaring binnen de cardiologie (of een zeer sterke affiniteit om je hier in te verdiepen); Je bent communicatief sterk, werkt graag autonoom en zoekt de samenwerking op. Wat bieden we jou? Bij CCN krijg je een salaris conform CAO Zelfstandige Klinieken Nederland (ZKN), een fulltime dienstverband bestaat uit een 40-urige werkweek. De CAO zorgt voor een aantrekkelijk pakket aan arbeidsvoorwaarden. We willen het beste voor jou, het team en de patiënt. Wij bieden je onder andere het volgende: Een salaris tussen €5.295,- tot €7.901,- conform FWG 65 (cao ZKN) o.b.v. 40 uur per week. We schalen je in op basis van jouw ervaring; Vakantiegeld (8,33%), een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,33% en deelname aan de pensioenregeling bij PFZW; Een jaarcontract voor 16-32 uur per week, met duidelijke intentie op een volgend contract voor onbepaalde tijd; Een gezonde werk-privébalans: wij bieden uitsluitend regelmaat. Je draait dus géén diensten in de weekenden of avond/nacht; 160 uur vakantieverlof en 72 PLB-uren o.b.v. een fulltime dienstverband; Reiskostenvergoeding van €0,23/km (er zijn parkeermogelijkheden bij deze locatie) of een NS business card voor woon-werkverkeer; Vakinhoudelijke en professionele ontwikkeling met onze interne klinische lessen en andere opleidingsmogelijkheden. We denken hierbij graag met je mee wat bij jou past; Extra secundaire arbeidsvoor

Heute ist das Netzwerk in 5 Ländern aktiv, zählt über 100 Partner und hat Hunderte von KMU geholfen, profitabler, stabiler und besser managebar zu werden. In Deutschland startete das Franchise Ende 2024 – jetzt kommt Nord- und Ostdeutschland. Als thexton armstrong Partner in Berlin, Hamburg, Hannover, Bremen, Leipzig, Dresden oder einer der anderen Metropolregionen der Region arbeiten Sie mit einem bewährten System, einer anerkannten Marke und einem Netzwerk gleichgesinnter Profis – europaweit. Das Geschäftsmodell Als Franchise Partner gewinnen Sie KMU-Inhaber (5-10 Klienten) als langfristige Mentoring-Mandate. Die Zusammenarbeit läuft über strukturierte KMU-Programme in drei Phasen: Discovery Session – Sie knüpfen eine Verbindung, verstehen die persönliche Motivation des Unternehmers, seine Hoffnungen und Herausforderungen. Profit Leakage Session – Mit dem thexton armstrong Online-Tool identifizieren Sie live, wo und wie viel Profit aus dem Unternehmen fließt. Sofortige, greifbare Erkenntnisse. Proposal Session – Gemeinsam planen Sie die Zusammenarbeit: welches Programm, welche Ziele, welche Schritte. Klienten unterschreiben Verträge mit monatlicher Abrechnung – das schafft planbare, wiederkehrende Einnahmen für Sie und entlastet die Cashflow-Planung des Klienten. Ein typisches Klienten-Portfolio: 5–10 KMU mit Mandatslaufzeiten von 12+ Monaten. Viele Beziehungen dauern mehrere Jahre. Ihre Aufgaben als Franchise Partner Klientenakquisition: Sie identifizieren und gewinnen KMU-Inhaber in Ihrer Region – durch Netzwerkarbeit, Empfehlungen und aktives Outreach. Business Mentoring: Sie begleiten Ihre Klienten langfristig bei Wachstum, Profitabilitätssteigerung, Restrukturierung und Unternehmensnachfolge. Profit Leakage Analysen: Sie führen strukturierte Unternehmensanalysen mit dem thexton armstrong Online-Tool durch und präsentieren klare, umsetzbare Erkenntnisse. Programmbegleitung: Sie steuern aktiv ein Portfolio von 5–10 KMU-Klienten durch maßgeschneiderte KMU-Programme (Wachstum, Stabilisierung, Exit). Netzwerkaufbau: Sie etablieren sich als anerkannter KMU-Experte in Ihrer Region – durch IHK-Engagements, Vorträge, Events und digitale Präsenz. Eigenes Unternehmertum: Sie führen Ihr eigenes Unternehmen – von der Akquisition über die Leistungserbringung bis zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung. Community & Netzwerk: Sie nehmen an regelmäßigen Peer-Exchanges, Trainings und Best-Practice-Sessions mit dem europaweiten thexton armstrong Netzwerk teil. Was Sie bei uns finden Neustart ohne Neuanfang: Ihre Erfahrung ist das Fundament – nicht das Problem. Unternehmerische Freiheit: Kein Chef, keine Konzernpolitik, keine Abstimmungsschleifen. Planbare Einnahmen: Langfristige Verträge und monatliche Abrechnung – keine Projektabhängigkeit. Echte Wirkung: Sie helfen KMU-Inhabern sichtbar und messbar – das motiviert täglich neu. Gemeinschaft: Ein Netzwerk gleichgesinnter Partner – kein einsames Freelancer-Dasein. Unterstützung von Anfang an: 10-15-tägiges Onboarding, laufendes Coaching, fertige Tools und Templates, Unterstützung bei der Leadgenerierung. Was Sie erhalten Exklusive Regionallizenz: Ihr eigenes, geschütztes Territorium in Nord/Ostdeutschland. Bewährte Methodik: Vollständige Toolbox inkl. Profit Leakage Applikation, Klientenprogramme, Playbooks und Templates – ab Tag 1 einsetzbar. 10-15-tägiges Onboarding: Intensive Einarbeitung in Foundation und KMU-Programme über zwei Monate – praxisnah und strukturiert. Laufendes Coaching: Regelmäßige 1-on-1-Begleitung durch den Master Franchise Partner C

jobs.title: TUM Project Study: Earned LinkedIn Media for Enterprise
jobs.description: About us Mediacharge GmbH is a Munich-based, internationally oriented marketing agency with ten years of experience in cutting-edge marketing for international enterprises. Operating in 14 languages, we combine first-tier strategic consulting with hands-on operational excellence, measured against business results. Project description (TUM Project) This project study explores what turns an enterprise’s own people into LinkedIn voices that measurably drive Sales, Recruiting or Employer Brand. Using Mediacharge and its enterprise clients as the case environment, it examines how earned media, meaning content published by real people rather than paid brand channels, creates business impact. The project combines a business strategy perspective - objectives, the right people and measurable outcomes - with a content and platform perspective, focusing on talent profiles, content types, success patterns and the time it takes to build an effective voice. Objectives of the project study to classify enterprise objectives for earned LinkedIn media (Sales, Recruiting, Employer Brand), to identify which talent profiles and content types work best for each objective, to derive success patterns, including what it takes and how long it takes to see results, to develop one strategy blueprint per objective and an impact model to measure business effect. Main task and methodology Students explore the topic through research, interviews and real enterprise cases (month 1), classify goals, talent profiles and success patterns (month 2), and build strategy blueprints, a final report and a pitch to Mediacharge leadership (month 3). Recommended methods include desk research, expert interviews, enterprise case analysis, benchmarking and impact modelling. Student requirements Students are fascinated by marketing at international enterprise scale, work analytically and build things that hold up in practice. jobs.title: Founding Recruiter (m/f/x)
jobs.description: 01 · Why this role exists Invest in Values. Produce in Freedom. Boost Europe. Behind every megawatt hour our clients save, there are people who make it happen. RIZM helps Europe's largest industrial companies – together around 2% of Europe's total energy demand – make their energy decisions with AI. Our agent RIZMO works as a digital colleague. But the most important colleagues are the ones we haven't found yet. That's your job. We're about 15 people today and growing fast. There is no recruiting playbook yet, no big HR department and no "that's how we've always done it". You'll write the playbook. Not as application admin, but as the person who shapes who RIZM becomes. 02 · Hi, we're Diana and Josh – we'll be working together I'm Diana, 20, I study civil engineering in Münster and I currently run recruiting at RIZM on my own, 20 hours a week. That's not enough for what's ahead of us, which is why we're looking for you. We'll build this together, side by side in our Münster office. Josh, our co-founder & CBO, comes from statistics and risk management and will be your sparring partner whenever you need one – for tricky candidates, for offers and for figuring out who we need next. Got questions before you apply? Just message me on LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/diana-pashaian-1637133b2/ 03 · What you'll do Build the team of tomorrow: Design our recruiting from scratch – roles, workflows, tools – and later bring more recruiters and sourcers on board yourself. Find the right people: Track down engineers, energy experts and product people via LinkedIn, Juicebox, universities, communities and your own network. Win people over: Lead first conversations, tell our story convincingly and make sure every candidate feels well looked after – even when it's a no. Make it smart: Automate sequences, screening and reporting with AI instead of maintaining spreadsheets. Steer by numbers: Always know where the funnel gets stuck – and turn the right dials. Get us seen: Shape how RIZM is perceived as an employer – careers page, job ads, events, university partnerships. 04 · What you bring Experience: You've worked in recruiting or talent acquisition, ideally in startups or tech, and you know how to approach technical profiles. People sense: You spot potential even when it's not on the CV, and you talk to engineers as equals. Tech affinity: You try out new tools, build your own workflows and enjoy making things faster. Builder drive: You don't want to step into ready-made structures – you want to create them, independently, reliably and fast. Background: A degree in psychology, business, HR, social sciences or similar – or a path that prepared you just as well. Languages: Fluent German and English, written and spoken. 05 · What you get Performance counts: Uncapped variable pay plus equity – good work is visible here and rewarded directly. Real ownership: You're the first recruiter. What you build stays. A network that moves you forward: Sparring, mentoring and learning with the networks of our investors Point 9 and Earlybird. Once a year, we get out: A team workation with everyone, including conversations with inspiring guests like Robert Habeck, Kitty Mayo or James Vincent. Stay fit: Urban Sports Club membership. Münster office: You sit right next to our engineering team – the people you'll hire most – and you hear first-hand what makes a great engineer at RIZM. Recruiting thrives on short distances – the best ideas come up at the same table. 06 · How to apply You don't need to write a classic cover letter. We don't think it tells us much about a person anymore. Instead, picture this: a few years from now, RIZM welcomes its 100th team member. There's a celebration in the Münster office. One of the first people you ever hired stands up to say a few words. - What's the one thing you hope they say about you? - And what have you done so far that makes you believe they would? A few honest sentences are enough. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: TYPO3 Developer
jobs.description: TYPO3 Developer (Mensch) Andere zählen Schafe. Du zählst TYPO3-Major-Versionen, die du schon migriert hast. Und hast Lust, die Websites großer, internationaler Unternehmen technisch zu verantworten? Zur Übersicht Der ultimative TYPO3-Check Du bist bei uns richtig, wenn du… … bei „Wir brauchen nur ein kleines Feld mehr im Backend“ im Kopf schon TCA, Datenbank-Migration und die drei Fluid-Templates aufklappst , die es wirklich braucht. … für dein wichtigstes Werkzeug hältst. Direkt nach dem Cache-Leeren. … beim Satz „Das ging in TYPO3 v7 aber noch“ freundlich lächelst und den Extension Scanner startest . … sofort merkst, wenn dir die KI eine TypoScript-Lösung aus dem Jahr 2014 andreht. Und sie trotzdem jeden Tag nutzt, weil sie dich schneller macht . … und dein Gewissen dir verbietet, freitags um 16 Uhr ein Major-Update auf Production zu schieben . Auch nicht „nur schnell“. … dann gilt für uns nur noch eins: composer require netfed/du Worum geht es? Du verantwortest die TYPO3-Technik großer Corporate-Websites. Von der Aufwandsschätzung über Konzeption und Neuaufbau bis zu Weiterentwicklung, Support und Updates. Du berätst Kolleg:innen und Kunden und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Projekte auf einem sauberen technischen Fundament stehen. Warum diese Rolle bei uns anders ist? Wir arbeiten für namhafte Konzerne und große Mittelständler, bei denen die Website ein strategisches Aushängeschild ist. Du baust hier nicht Website Nummer 47 nach Schema F. Du triffst die technischen Entscheidungen und verantwortest die Architektur. Dabei vertrauen wir voll auf deine Erfahrung. Dazu kommen eine eigene, von uns betriebene Cloud-Hosting-Umgebung und eine gelebte DevOps-Kultur, die sich am Stand der Technik orientiert. Und was ist mit KI? Gehört bei uns zum Alltag. Nicht als Pilotprojekt, sondern als Werkzeug. Du arbeitest mit KI als Sparringspartner: beim Refactoring, beim Testen, beim Dokumentieren, beim schnellen Zweitblick auf eine Migration. Die KI schlägt vor, du entscheidest. Genau deshalb suchen wir jemanden mit echter TYPO3-Erfahrung, der erkennt, wann ein Vorschlag gut ist und wann er Unsinn ist. Was sind deine Aufgaben? Du erstellst die technische Konzeption neu aufzubauender TYPO3-Websites. Du verantwortest die TYPO3-Aspekte großer Kundenprojekte: Aufwandsschätzung, Neuaufbau, Weiterentwicklung, Support und Updates. Du setzt KI-Tools im Entwickleralltag ein und bringst unseren KI-Einsatz in der Entwicklung weiter voran. Du dokumentierst so, dass andere weiterarbeiten können. Auch dein zukünftiges Ich. Beratung und Support Du berätst Kolleg:innen und Kunden bei technischen Themen, zum Beispiel bei der Wahl der CMS-Architektur. Du bearbeitest Kunden-Tickets und Support-Anfragen, die unser First-Level-Support nicht direkt lösen kann. Du übersetzt Technik in Kunden-Deutsch und Kundenwünsche in saubere Technik. Was bringst du mit? 4 bis 8 Jahre Erfahrung mit der Umsetzung anspruchsvoller Websites auf Basis von TYPO3. Du kennst dich mit den umgebenden Tools und Technologien aus, zum Beispiel Composer, JSON, JavaScript und XML. Du beherrschst den Umgang mit SQL-Datenbanken, zum Beispiel MariaDB. Du arbeitest mit KI-Coding-Tools und weißt, wo sie helfen und wo nicht. Du arbeitest gern agil mit Jira, Confluence und GitLab. Wäre gut, aber kein Muss Erfahrung mit WordPress. Erfahrung mit Solr oder Elasticsearch. Praxis mit Docker, Kubernetes und DevOps-Methoden. Rahmenbedingungen Werkzeuge: Jira, Confluence, GitLab, Office 365, Docker, Kubernetes Infrastruktur: Eigene Cloud-Hosting-Umgebung mit technologischem Freiraum, in der Entwicklung und im Live-Betrieb Starkes Netzwerk: Als Teil der team neusta Gruppe hast du kurze Wege zu über 800 Expert:innen, wenn dein Projekt zusätzliche Spezialpower braucht. jobs.title: Senior Fraud & Risk Analyst (f/m/x)

You'll work cross-functionally with different teams, dig into fraud patterns across our platform, and build the processes we don't have yet. Process ownership: Own the design of fraud and risk processes end-to-end, spotting gaps and building what doesn't exist yet. Experimentation: Test, learn, and iterate - running A/B tests to continuously sharpen our fraud prevention strategies. Strategic thinking: Think beyond the day-to-day, helping define where fraud and risk management goes next as the team scales. Mentorship & collaboration: Mentor teammates and partner cross-functionally with Tech, Data, Product, Support, and Finance - becoming a go-to person others rely on. What You Bring Fraud & risk experience: 5+ years in fraud, risk management, or a closely related financial risk function; direct fraud experience is a strong plus, ideally in gaming or another B2C/app-based industry. Data & AI fluency: Comfort working with data - SQL, databases, and hands-on experience using AI tools for analysis and prompting. Analytical mindset: Strong analytical skills and genuine comfort with numbers, paired with the ability to turn analysis into clear, actionable reporting. Strategic contribution: Experience contributing to or developing risk/fraud strategy, not just executing existing processes — including running A/B tests to validate ideas. Collaboration & mentorship: Experience mentoring or supporting colleagues, and working cross-functionally across different stakeholder perspectives. Education: A relevant Bachelor's or Master's degree (Business, Finance, Accounting, Data/Mathematics, Engineering, or similar). Language: Fluent English, written and spoken. Nice to have: Background in policy design or risk governance frameworks. Relevant certifications such as CFE, CFCS, CAMS, CRISC, CFA, and/or FRM. Working knowledge of relevant regulatory frameworks - e.g. GDPR, PSD2/SCA, AML/KYC principles, and PCI-DSS basics where payment data is processed. How We Win Speed is the feature. Speed beats rocket science. We move fast, test fast, and multiply our pace with AI, because action creates information and small wins compound. A fast failure is a lesson we learn from, a slow one is a problem we can't afford. Focus on the essential. Done is better than perfect. We stay focused on what actually moves us forward and protect people's time from anything that doesn't. We're direct in how we communicate too, no rambling, no unnecessary detail. See it. Own it. Solve it. The first to see it is best placed to fix it.

jobs.title: Chief of Staff
jobs.description: About Nous Nous is a household AI agent. It takes over the bills and admin people don't have time for and acts for them: switching energy, buying insurance, cancelling forgotten subscriptions, managing the family calendar. Nearly 250,000 UK households have signed up, and another joins every minute. We think the real value of AI isn't writing amazing cover letters, it's doing useful things in the real world for real people. That's the hard part, and a brilliant product is only half of it. An energy switch takes weeks, so our agents run on long-running workflows, not a single chat turn. Cancelling a subscription means a browser agent handling the code Apple sends to your phone. Buying insurance meant getting our regulatory principal comfortable with an agent doing it end to end (a UK first), which comes down to knowing exactly when the LLM should hand over to rules because a mistake would cost someone real money. We're about 30 people running one agent across energy, broadband, mobile, insurance, mortgages and subscriptions (with more being added), each with its own suppliers, rules and ways of going wrong. With far more problems than people, a person or small team owns each one end to end, from spotting it in the data or a customer conversation to shipping the fix. And because the agent acts, you find out quickly whether the fix worked. Everyone builds here: a product engineer launched our subscription cancellation product within a couple of months of joining, and a PM rebuilt our WhatsApp agent. And it's working. We're growing more than 20x year on year, with a market-leading NPS above +80, and we manage well over half a billion pounds of household spending. We've raised more than $30M from Heartcore, Mosaic and a who's who of entrepreneurs who founded Monzo, GoCardless, lastminute.com and Onfido. But the real draw is the team - ask anyone here why they joined and you'll get some version of "to do great work with really smart people". The goal is household life that's simpler, cheaper and fairer, and most of that is still to build. Why we're hiring Nous runs on small teams with real ownership and barely any middle management. That's a big part of how about 30 of us became one of the UK's fastest-growing startups. It also means the work of joining everything up has been spread across the founders and leads, squeezed in around their day jobs. Plans, OKRs, closing the hires that matter, the big company pushes: everyone does a bit of it and nobody owns it. Last week showed what happens when someone does. We ran "crunch week": five days where most of the company dropped its normal work to relaunch Nous as a household agent. Twelve workstreams, one owner each, a short daily sync and a pre-mortem. In a week we rebuilt onboarding and the website, shipped new agent capabilities, and got legal, security and comms ready for launch. As one of the team said afterwards, when we cluster around a problem for a bit, we do loads of work. We want that pace more of the time, without a founder having to drop everything to run it. So we're hiring a Chief of Staff. About the role You'll work directly with Greg (our CEO) and the founding team, and own how Nous runs day to day: the pace, planning and OKRs, and the big company pushes, plus overseeing hiring and helping land the hires that matter most. You'll sit in the management meeting and get the full picture, including the things that aren't public yet. And you'll have the authority to change how we work: cancel or reshape meetings, and move people and cut scope during a big push. You enjoy coordinating, but only because it gets things done faster. You'd rather get a decision made today than design a process for making decisions. What you'll actually do Set the pace. Spot what's stuck, work out why, and get it moving. Usually it's a decision nobody has made yet, so you get it made, or make it yourself. Own planning and OKRs. Quarterly OKRs, the weekly management meeting, planning and offsites. Squa

jobs.description: Olo is a leading SaaS platform accelerating digital transformation in the restaurant industry, by helping customers deliver more personalised and profitable guest experiences. If you are passionate about reducing risk while supporting innovation, we encourage you to apply!   You can work remotely from anywhere in Northern Ireland. You will provide strategic and technical oversight to the team and the program. Technically lead a team of security engineers and analysts who hunt, detect, and respond to internal and external threats. Collaborate with customers and partners to strengthen their security posture. Drive ongoing optimisations by implementing new technologies, replacing technologies, addressing evolving threats, scaling practices and automating security activities. Oversee Vulnerability Management program including vulnerability assessments, risk scoring and vulnerability resolution. Oversee Threat Hunting program to detect and mitigate advanced threats. Apply Web application and API security principles and techniques, such as zero trust, RBAC, authentication, authorization, auditing, rate limiting, challenges, etc., to protect our cloud-based services from unauthorized access and abuse. Incident Detection and Response Oversee Incident Detection and Response program including ownership of incident response processes, tools and services and the ongoing continuous improvement of those controls. Coordinate the detection and response to attacks through all incident phases. Ensure incident reports are accurate, detailed and relevant. Monitor, detect, and remediate misconfigurations and security risks across our cloud environments.  Participate in a 24/7 on-call rotation. Security Services Oversee Security Services program including security support requests, risk assessments, vendor assessments, PCI and SOC audit support and service provider management. What We'll Expect from You 5+ years of Security Engineering, Security Operations or Security Architecture experience. CISSP, GCIH or similar certification preferred. Experience acting as technical lead to distributed teams consisting largely of remote engineers. Experience complying with PCI-DSS and other compliance and regulatory standards. Experience with attacker tactics, techniques and procedures. Knowledge of information technology, evolving threats, attack patterns, incident response and cyber security standards. Experience developing and leading incident response, remediation and mitigation activities, and providing status updates and reports

jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer
jobs.description: Building the intelligence behind Solskin Are you a driven person who wants to make buildings come alive? We are Zurich Soft Robotics (ZSR), a Zurich-based startup developing Solskin – a climate-adaptive solar facade. Solskin is not just a PV system or a shading system; it’s an intelligent skin that uses weather and building data, occupant feedback, and AI algorithms to decide how the facade moves, so buildings stay comfortable, avoid overheating, and use energy as efficiently as possible. Solskin is already running on several buildings across Switzerland, with many more to follow. In this role, you own the software that makes that happen. You write the code that runs Solskin, keep it reliable in the field, and constantly improve it. You will also architect and lead our future sensor-to-data platform. Your focus is where software meets hardware, and the control and AI on top of it. You don't need to be a front-end specialist. What you will do This is a hands-on leadership position: you code every day. Own the full stack: You maintain and develop the whole software stack, from cloud and data management to user-facing applications, and from low-level embedded firmware to high-level AI controllers learning from users. You keep it reliable and keep making it better. Be the link between the teams: You build the software that runs on real buildings and support the hardware team. You also build the internal tools used by sales and the business team. Lead what comes next : With the CEO and CTO, you set the software direction and lead development of future products. Our stack: Backend: Python, FastAPI, PyTorch Frontend: React, TypeScript Hardware: C/C++, STM32 microcontrollers, Beckhoff PLCs Database: PostgreSQL (TimescaleDB) DevOps & Cloud: Linux, Docker, AWS, Grafana What we are looking for Required: Education : MSc or PhD in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, or similar. Python : This is a must. You write clean Python that runs in production, on real systems. Embedded & Hardware: Shipped C/C++ on microcontrollers running on physical hardware; comfortable working with sensors, actuators, and basic electronics. Applied AI & Control: Understanding of modern control and ML/RL methods, with hands-on PyTorch experience applied to physical or dynamic systems. Cloud & data : You are comfortable with PostgreSQL, Docker and AWS. Leadership attitude : You take ownership, make decisions, and want to grow as a leader. Languages : English. German is a big plus. Hybrid setting : You will be expected to be on-site at least three days per week, and sometimes at customers’ locations, to work on real products. Availability : 100%, as soon as possible. Work-permit: You need the right to work in Switzerland for this position. Preferred: Startup experience: You have worked in a startup before and know what that means. Building modeling and control: You have prior experience handling building data, modeling building dynamics, and developing building controllers; ideally with ML and RL tools. Frontend: React and TypeScript. Mindset: Hands-on: You lead, and you still do the hard work yourself. Fast: You are pragmatic and iterate quickly. Things break, and plans change, and that doesn't scare you. Purpose: You care about climate and want to make buildings smarter. Benefits Impact: Your code runs on real buildings. You see the result of your work. Ownership: A key role with a real say in our product and technology, and room to grow with the company. Flexibility: Hybrid work and flexible hours. We like being in the Zurich office together, so plan for regular office days. Team: A small, skilled, and down-to-earth team that helps each other out. The reality: We are a startup. It is often messy; things rarely work the first time, and the workload is real. In return, you get a lot of freedom and responsibility from day one. Sounds like you? As Global Head of Sales you own new business revenue across every market. You lead our Sales Leads in the Netherlands, Germany and South Africa and the Account Executive teams below them, and you build the organisation that takes SOUS from a fast-growing startup to the category leader for independent hospitality. It is a senior role with full ownership, real equity and a direct line to the founders. Your team You join the commercial leadership team and report directly to our CCO and co-founder. jobs.description: Senior Software-Entwickler (m/w/d) – PHP/Symfony & React – Berlin Der Plan steht, jetzt fehlst du: Bring unsere Software von Legacy-PHP auf Symfony und React. jobs.description: We are Kolibri Games - a mobile games developer from Berlin. We believe that with the best people, we can make games that players will enjoy for years to come. Our games have defined the idle genre, and bring enjoyment to hundreds of millions of players all around the world. This is possible due to the talented people who make us who we are. ‘Kolibris’, as we call ourselves, are on a mission to continue making great games and we're looking for new talent to join our team. We strive to offer you a fair recruitment process and a great candidate experience, as well as a friendly environment to work in, with plenty of opportunities to learn and grow. Game Data Analyst (f/m/d) Are you curious about what makes games engaging? Do you enjoy understanding not just what players do, but why they do it, and turning that understanding into clear, actionable insights? We are looking for a Game Data Analyst to strengthen our product analytics capabilities. In this role, you will combine strong analytical thinking with solid technical foundations to support multiple game teams over time.  This is an individual contributor role with a strong emphasis on data modeling, advanced analysis, and scalable analytical foundations. Responsibilities Partner with product and game teams to answer complex questions around player behavior, engagement, and progression Perform advanced analyses using SQL to uncover patterns and drivers behind player actions Design and analyze player segmentation and behavioral cohorts Design, implement, and evaluate A/B tests to measure feature performance, optimize player experiences, and guide data-informed decisions. Build and maintain reliable, analytics-ready data models (experience with dbt or similar tools) Ensure data quality, clarity, and documentation of key datasets and metrics Contribute to self-serve reporting and visualization Partner with cross-functional teams to align priorities, influence roadmap decisions, and ensure analytics is central to shaping the player experience. Collaborate with other analysts and data infrastructure team to improve analytical workflows and standards Required Skills 3+ years of experience in Data Analytics Proficiency in SQL and data visualization tools Experience working with complex datasets and analytical data models Ability to translate data into clear insights for both technical and non-technical audiences Curiosity, ownership, and eagerness to learn new tools and approaches Desirable Skills Experience with Looker and dbt Experience with Python or R for data analysis. Familiarity with data orchestration tools (e.g. Airflow) Background in games, free-to-play, or product analytics Kolibri Games is an equal opportunity employer. We come from 40 different countries and many different backgrounds. We celebrate diversity and we are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, regardless of their age, gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, physical appearance or disability. We look forward to hearing from you! jobs.description: At Klim, we work with farmers and food companies to make regenerative agriculture scalable and financially rewarding for farmers. Through our platform, we help farmers restore soil health, increase biodiversity and capture carbon while creating new, reliable income streams. Since 2020, we’ve supported 3,500 farmers managing over 900,000 hectares. If you’re passionate about building a sustainable food system and driving real climate impact, join us and help create a healthier planet! Your mission: As our (Senior) Finance Manager, you will run all aspects of Finance at Klim. From HGB accounting and the monthly and annual close, through day-to-day financial operations, to audits, controlling and finance projects — you own the full breadth of the finance function end-to-end. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with unusually broad responsibility: you are the person who keeps our financial engine room running accurately, reliably and on time, and who continuously makes it simpler, faster and more automated. You are supported by a working student whose work you steer, and you report directly to our COO. This role is a great fit for you if you are a finance all-rounder who wants genuine ownership of the entire finance function and the opportunity to make a real impact from day one. With a broad mix of strategic, tactical and operational responsibility, you’ll have plenty of room to shape how we work, improve what’s already there and build an automated Finance function. jobs.title: Senior Consulting Engineer
jobs.description: <h3>The team</h3> <p>MongoDB's Application Modernization Platform (AMP) organization is the front door of our modernization business. In our Data Migration practice we move production data - safely, repeatably, at enterprise scale - from relational estates (Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL) and from NoSQL platforms (Apache Cassandra, Azure Cosmos DB, Amazon DocumentDB) onto MongoDB. We do this both as standalone migration programmes and as the data workstream inside larger application-modernization engagements, using MongoDB's own tooling - Relational Migrator, Cluster-to-Cluster Sync, Atlas Stream Processing - alongside the open-source and cloud-native pipeline ecosystem.&nbsp;</p> <p>Our mission is to help our customers be successful by leading end-to-end their journey to MongoDB. In an era where AI agents handle routine migration mechanics - such as workload assessments, schema and query translations, and large-scale validation - our consultants focus on the high-judgment decisions that directly mitigate risk. Joining us now means helping draft the playbooks while they are actively being defined. We are seeking builders who prefer creating new frameworks over following legacy instructions.</p> <p>This role will be based remotely in Germany.</p> <h3>Position expectations</h3> <p>Delivery</p> <ul> <li>Plan and lead the technical delivery of data migration engagements end to end: source estate assessment, migration strategy and wave planning, schema and data-model transformation, pipeline build, validation, and production cutover with minimal downtime</li> <li>Design and operate change data capture (CDC) pipelines for zero and near-zero-downtime migrations - using Kafka and the connector ecosystem, Debezium and comparable log-based CDC tooling, and cloud-native replication services</li> <li>Bring genuine platform depth on the estates our customers are leaving: Cassandra data modeling and anti-patterns, Cosmos DB (Core and Mongo API) partitioning and RU economics, DocumentDB's compatibility surface - and use it to de-risk what the customer cannot see coming</li> <li>Work shoulder to shoulder with enterprise customers - architects, DBAs, platform teams and executives - from whiteboard to war room</li> <li>Own the full consulting lifecycle for your engagements, from planning and agenda-setting through post-engagement follow-up, surfacing risks and further opportunities back to Sales and Professional Services</li> </ul> <p>Pre-sales and growth</p> <ul> <li>Partner with Solutions Architects, Engagement Managers and account teams to scope and size migration opportunities, shape statements of work and estimation models, and give sales well-founded confidence in what is achievable and what it will take</li> <li>Cultivate your reputation as a migrations SME and trusted advisor, internally and in the market, and positively influence your own utilization through proactive customer engagement</li> <li>Identify services opportunities in our customers, new workloads or estates to be migrated or product improvements the customer could benefit from</li> </ul> <p>Building the practice</p> <ul> <li>Build and harden the AI tooling that makes migrations faster and safer: agents for automated estate assessment, schema and data-model conversion, query and code translation, and large-scale data validation - and fold what works into the standard delivery methodology</li> <li>Turn field experience into reusable assets: migration playbooks, reference architectures, estimation models, tooling improvements and enablement for the wider team</li> <li>Partner with Product and Engineering to bring field reality into MongoDB's product and migration-tooling roadmap</li> </ul>

jobs.title: Senior Category Manager, Womenswear UK/EU
jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>ABOUT QUINCE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes&nbsp; and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.</p> <p>What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.</p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>OUR CULTURE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.</p> <ul> <li>We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA.&nbsp; Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.</li> <li>Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.&nbsp;</li> <li>Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.</p></div><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>THE ROLE</strong></span></p> <p><strong>Senior Category Manager, Women's UK/EU</strong></p> <p>We are seeking a <strong>Senior Category Manager, Women's UK/EU</strong><strong>&nbsp;</strong>to join our growing team. This role is suited to a data-driven product obsessed all-rounder. Industry leaders like Unilever, Uber, Anthropic, Snowflake or Siemens, use Pigment daily to make more informed decisions and confidently navigate any scenario.   With a team of 700+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco and Austin, we've raised nearly $400M from top-tier investors and were named a Visionary in the 2024 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software.   At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo - all while working as one team. If you're driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you. You’ll join Pigment’s Reporting & Collaboration community , working as a senior hands-on Frontend Engineer on some of the most complex parts of the product. This community is responsible for how users access, configure and interact with their data. That creates significant frontend challenges around large-scale datasets, filtering, visualisation, complex configuration and increasingly AI-powered experiences. On the engineering part: Spend approximately 80% of your time as a hands-on engineer , designing, building and shipping production features. Work on complex, data-heavy frontend problems where performance, usability and scale all matter. Build sophisticated interfaces for displaying, filtering and interacting with large datasets. Work with React, TypeScript and JavaScript, while contributing to the wider technical decisions behind the product. Partner closely with Product Managers, Product Designers and Engineers to take features from problem definition through to production. Make pragmatic engineering decisions based on the needs of the product and its users, rather than pursuing technical complexity for its own sake. Contribute to areas across Reporting & Collaboration depending on business needs and your interests, including data extraction and filtering, visualisation, complex configuration and emerging AI experiences. Use modern engineering tooling, with Pigment teams working across GCP, CircleCI and AI development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor and GitHub Copilot. This is not a traditional Engineering Manager role where you step away from the code. You will remain a senior individual contributor and be expected to ship.   On the people management part, here is what it entails: At Pigment, people management and technical leadership are deliberately separated . Tech Leads lead the technical direction of individual teams. Engineering Managers focus on developing engineers as people while remaining hands-on engineers themselves. Spend approximately 20% of your time on people management . Gradually take on direct reports after establishing yourself as an IC during your probation period. Coach engineers across different teams within the Reporting & Collaboration community. Support engineers with career progression, development, feedback and performance. Run regular 1:1s and help engineers understand what they need to do to progress. Set clear expectations and provide actionable feedback. Handle difficult performance conversations when necessary and follow through with clear development plans. Partner with Tech Leads to understand how your reports are performing technically without taking ownership of the Tech Lead's responsibilities. Help create an environment where strong engineers can continue to develop while doing their best work.
